description: This file contains test specifications for verifying battery-related method calls within a Playwright test environment. It mocks the Battery API, overrides certain methods, and asserts expected behaviors and logged calls.

methods.name: test.beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing logs, exposing a logging function to the page context, and injecting a script to mock the Battery API.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines a test case that navigates to the page, checks the battery percentage display, and verifies that specific battery-related API calls were made.
